claims.assertion: Mari says Avyon near Vega is the Urmah homeworld, about 25 light-years from Earth; Urmah live across the galaxy.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Urmah society has a holistic monarchy and High Council; lions lead, tigers serve militarily, and other felines fill varied roles.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says the Urmah Federation spans many worlds and secured special Galactic Federation autonomy, with treaties with Alcyone, Taygeta and Engan.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

review_flags: Avyon is described as Vega’s second planet in p0003, but p0004 calls it the first.
